title: Add client-owned lifetime holds to whoopsie-preferences
description:
Add client-owned lifetime holds to whoopsie-preferences

Port daemon lifetime to GApplication, preserving the 60-second idle timeout.
 
Add unauthenticated Hold/Release methods. Holds belong to the calling connection and are removed on disconnect. Preserve the public interface ABI.
 
Fix resource ownership and keep pending Polkit authorization requests alive.
 
Built and installed locally. Confirmed idle shutdown, Telemetry keep-alive, unprivileged holds, rejection of another connection’s Release, and disconnect cleanup.
